blurb: Guests board vessels in downtown Victoria to watch for whales such as Orcas and Humpbacks, as well as other marine wildlife. Tours run year-round with a 95% whale sighting success rate and a free return trip if no whales are seen. The company emphasizes sustainability and education about marine ecosystems.

quotes.text: What an amazing trip and crew !! Richard, Sandy, Eden & Jane felt in safe hands and information along the way fabulous. Saw Killer Whale, Humpback and they made sure we had the experience, with there patience to see these amazing beautiful creatures in there natural world scenery breathtaking

This was an outstanding excursion and I would highly recommend it. A humpback whale hung out around our boat for about 30 minutes. The crew was amazing! Specifically would like to point out that Captain Lindsey, first hand Stephen, and Naturalists Andrei, Amber and Sam did a fantastic job!

I had such a fun time with my friends here! We saw so many whales and seals and all sorts of amazing creatures! Our driver, Mark, knew so much about the whales we were seeing and it truely brought the experience to life and made it so magical! 10/10!

Wonderful experience! Captain Richard , Taylor , Reid . Becky and Michael all fix a fantastic job to make sure we all saw some truly amazing sights. Many thanks for the experience, the memories and the fantastic photos! Definitely would recommend!!

Great experience! Everyone in the crew was super knowledgeable and friendly, it is a super plus to have the pictures for free since me and my boyfriend could enjoy the beautiful of moment of seeing lots of animals in their environment.
The crew were friendly and helpful. The photos package from the tour was a great gift. I recommend it as it was a unique experience for me . Thanks to Cailtlin, Fawkes, Tobin and captain Roman🙏
